Unlike many facilities that offer an overwhelming array of options, we prioritize treatments with proven clinical efficacy and well-documented outcomes. Every service we provide undergoes rigorous evaluation before being introduced to our patients. We do not offer experimental procedures or treatments with indeterminate results, and we will never charge clients for services that do not meet our strict standards for safety, science, and effectiveness. Our commitment is to excellence, not excess. Our Story At PM Aesthetics, we are redefining modern beauty through innovation, clinical excellence, and personalized care. With our location in Bedford, New Hampshire, PM Aesthetics is proud to serve clients across New England with a consistent standard of luxury and results-driven treatment. ​ Our philosophy is simple: offer only the most effective, evidence-based treatments, never experimental services, with transparency, integrity, and compassion. From non-surgical facial rejuvenation and laser technologies to advanced skin care and medical weight loss, our offerings are curated to deliver real, lasting confidence. ​ Every client is welcomed into a warm, elegant environment where their needs are placed above sales targets or commissions. Whether you're just beginning your aesthetic journey or are looking for a trusted partner for life, PM Aesthetics is where your beauty goals meet expert care. Commitment to Excellence At PM Aesthetics, we are redefining what it means to experience medical aesthetics. As a leader in the industry, we blend cutting-edge technology with the highest standards of personalized care. Our providers undergo rigorous quarterly training to remain at the forefront of the safest, most advanced techniques in aesthetics and wellness. ​ But what truly sets us apart is our philosophy: we are not here to make a sale—we are here to make a lifelong connection. Every treatment plan is curated with integrity and precision, free from the influence of commissions or upselling. Our team is entirely focused on what’s appropriate for you, because your trust is more valuable than a one-time transaction. ​ We are proud to offer a luxury experience defined by warmth, honesty, and transparency. From the moment you walk through our doors, you’ll be cared for by a dedicated team committed to your comfort, results, and long-term well-being. ​ We are committed to transparency, innovation, and exceptional service: ​ 24/7 Concierge Service: Enjoy seamless access to our team anytime via call or text for questions, follow-up, or scheduling. Transparent Pricing & Procedures: We demystify the process with clear communication and upfront pricing, no surprises, just clarity. Commitment to Innovation: We drive accessibility by adopting best-in-class technologies that maintain our signature standard of quality and safety. At PM Aesthetics, we don’t just want to be your provider, we want to be your partner in confidence, health, and beauty for years to come. Meet our Wonderful Team Learn about the bright and talented people that make up the PM Aesthetics family. Dr. Cecilia Keady, DNP, APRN Medical Director, licensed in NH, MA, VT, and FL With over 26 years of medical experience, Dr. Keady brings a unique blend of clinical expertise and aesthetic artistry to the field of advanced non-surgical cosmetic medicine. Her medical journey began with four years of medical school in Mexico before relocating to the United States, where she earned a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN), a Master of Science in Nursing (MSN), and ultimately, a Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) degree. This comprehensive education forms the foundation of her evidence-based, patient-centered approach. ​ Dr. Keady has worked extensively with patients undergoing rapid and significant weight loss, giving her a deep understanding of the physical and emotional changes that can follow—particularly the facial volume loss often referred to as “Ozempic face.” She is dedicated to educating patients on these effects and offering proactive, personalized treatments to restore facial balance, confidence, and natural beauty. ​ Her work focuses on high-impact, non-surgical procedures designed to smooth fine lines, restore volume, enhance lip shape, and rejuvenate skin tone and elasticity through advanced techniques such as microneedling and radiofrequency treatments. Fluent in four languages and grounded in a multicultural perspective, Dr. Keady fosters an inclusive, welcoming environment for all patients. Her approach is always individualized, clinically sound, and deeply respectful of both science and personal aesthetics. Whether patients are navigating the changes that come with weight loss or seeking graceful aging solutions, Dr. Keady is committed to helping them feel empowered, confident, and cared for at every stage. ​ Certifications: Botulinum Toxin and Dermal Filler, Advanced Botulinum Toxin and Dermal Filler, Cannulas, Tear Trough Anna Keady, PA Aesthetic Director, licensed in NH and MA Anna Keady is a certified Physician Assistant specializing in medical aesthetics since 2022. She offers a wide range of advanced treatments, including neurotoxins, dermal fillers, liquid BBLs, and energy-based device therapies. Anna takes a holistic approach to aesthetics, focusing on each patient as a whole to create customized treatment plans that enhance natural beauty and boost confidence. ​ Certifications: Botulinum Toxin and Dermal Filler, Advanced Botulinum Toxin and Dermal Filler, Cannulas, Tear Trough Jaime Stone, APRN Aesthetic NP Jaime has 30 years of experience in healthcare, being an RN for 22 years with a background in Critical Care, Surgical Recovery, IV Therapy, and Trauma. She has been an NP for nearly 5 years and has a passion for health, nutrition and beauty. She worked in Baltimore in Pulmonary and Sleep Medicine, as well as in Aesthetics working with lasers, skin resurfacing, weight loss, and body contouring. ​ Certifications: Dermal Filler, Neurotoxin, Kybella, Sculptra. Michele Dwyer RN Injector licensed in MA and NH Michele, RN, believes confidence begins with healthy skin. She partners with each patient to build a thoughtful plan that blends clinical expertise and artistry, favoring subtle, natural-looking results that age gracefully. Known for clear guidance and a gentle touch, Michele practices evidence-based care and pursues ongoing training to deliver safe, precise outcomes. Emma Tanguay Esthetician Emma is a licensed aesthetician with more than three years of hands-on experience in advanced skincare. At 23, she has established herself as a trusted provider known for her attention to detail and commitment to client care. Emma specializes in DiamondGlow facials and SaltFacials , two results-driven treatments designed to deeply exfoliate, hydrate, and rejuvenate the skin. She also provides a wide range of esthetic services, tailoring each treatment to address individual concerns and help clients achieve their personal skin health goals. With a passion for both science-backed skincare and client comfort, Emma takes pride in creating treatment experiences that deliver visible results while promoting long-term skin health.
